module_summary: Bit-serial full adder: a carry flip-flop stores majority(a,b,c) each cycle while q outputs the combinational sum a^b^c.

anchors.name: c
anchors.why: Single-bit carry state register, updated with majority of a, b and itself; feeds sum and state output.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: Serial sum output bit a^b^c, the module's primary result.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Serial operand bit A feeding sum and carry logic.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Serial operand bit B feeding sum and carry logic.

groups.name: carry_state
groups.description: Carry flip-flop holding serial carry, exposed on the state output.

groups.name: sum_logic
groups.description: XOR sum of operand bits and stored carry driving q.
